tei:p.tei:seg: And now may the power of the Lord appear great, as Thou hast said.
Remember Thy mercies, O Lord, and andand Thy kindnesses, for they exist since eternity.

tei:div.tei:p: Exalted and sanctified be His Great Name in the world which He has created according to His will. May His Kingdom be established in your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of the whole House of Israel, speedily and in a short time, and say: Amen!
May His GrantGreat Name be praised to eternity and the eternity of eternities!

Blessed and praised and glorified and elevated and exalted and adorned and raised on high and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He; high, yea high, above all blessing and song, praise and comfort that have ever been spoken in the world, and say Amen!

tei:p.tei:seg: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, the great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love.
Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God.
O King, helper and saviour and shield, blessed art Thou, O Lord, the shield of Abraham.

tei:p.tei:seg: Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save. Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling and healing the sick and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion.
And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who revives the dead.

tei:p.tei:seg: Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes of all the living. Bring near our dispersed ones from among the nations and collect our scattered ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion, Thy city, in mirth, and to Jerusalem the House of Thy sanctuary, in eternal joy. There we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations, the regular offerings according to their order and the additional offerings according to their rule. And the additional offerings of this day of memorial we will prepare and offer up before Thee in love according to the commandment of Thy will as Thou hast written for us in Thy Torah through Moses Thy servant from Thy glorious mouth, saying:

Let them all be satisfied and find delight out of Thine abundance. Thou hast favoured the seventh day and sanctified it, the most precious of days hast Thou called it, a reminder of the work of creation.

tei:p.tei:seg: It is right for us to praise the Master of everything, and ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, that He has not made us like the nations of the lands and has not placed us like the families of the earth, that He has not made our portion like theirs nor our destiny like that of all their multitude. We kneel, bow down and give thanks before the Supreme King of kings, the Holy One blessed be He, who has extended the heavens and founded the earth and His glorious dwelling is in Heaven above and His mighty presence in the loftiest heights. He is our God, there is no other. In truth He is our King, there is none besides Him. As it is written in His Torah:
‘And you shall know this day and repeat it in your heart that the Lord is God in the heavens above and that on earth below there is no other.’

tei:p.tei:seg: Therefore we hope for Thee, O Lord our God, that we may soon behold the glory of Thy strength, that abominations may disappear from the earth and idols be entirely cut down, so that the world may be remedied through the Kingdom of the Almighty and all children of man may call upon Thy Name, and all the wicked of the earth may turn to Thee. All inhabitants of the world will perceive and know that to

Thee every knee should bow and every tongue swear. Before Thee, O Lord our God, will they kneel and fall and to the glory of Thy Name will they grant honour and they will all accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom. And Thou shalt soon reign over them for ever and ever. For Thine is the Kingdom and for all eternity shalt Thou reign in glory

tei:p.tei:seg: Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it
and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all.
Our God and God of our fathers, take pleasure in our rest.
Sanctify us through Thy commandments and grant our portion in Thy Torah, satisfy us with Thy goodness and gladden us with Thy help
and grant us, O Lord our God, in love and favour, Thy holy Sabbath as a portion so that Israel, who sanctifies Thy Name, may rest on it
and purify our heart to serve Thee in truth for Thou, O Lord, art truth and Thy word is truth and endures for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King over the whole earth, who sanctifies
the Sabbath and
Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

tei:p.tei:seg: Thou rememberest the work of the world and Thou art aware of all creatures of antiquity. Before Thee all secrets are revealed and the multitude of hidden things from the beginning of time. There is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and there is nought concealed before Thine eyes. Thou rememberest every deed and not even one creature is hidden from Thee. Everything is exposed and known before Thee, O Lord our God, watching and looking to the end of all generations. For Thou dost bring a fixed time for remembrance, when every spirit and soul will be considered and many deeds and an infinite mass of creatures will be remembered. From the beginning hast Thou made this known and long ago revealed it. This is the day of the beginning of Thy works, a memorial of the first day, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob. And regarding territories, it is decided on it which shall be for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty. And the creatures will be considered on it to be mentioned either for life or death. Who is not considered on this day? Indeed the memory of every created thing comes before Thee, man’s work and his task, the actions of man’s footsteps, man’s thought and his devices, and the motives of man’s deeds. Fortunate the man who does not forget Thee and the

son of man who clings to Thee, for those that seek Thee will never stumble nor will those that take refuge with Thee ever be disgraced. For the remembrance of all actions comes before Thee and Thou dost examine all of them. Noah also didst Thou remember in love and consider for the sake of salvation and compassion when Thou didst bring the waters of the flood to destroy all flesh because of the wickedness of their actions. Therefore his memory came before Thee, O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea, as it is written in Thy Torah:

Thus let Thy compassion subdue Thy wrath from upon us and in Thy great goodness let the fury of Thine anger turn back from Thy people, Thy city and Thine inheritance. Fulfil for us, O Lord our God, the word that Thou hast promised us in Thy Torah, through Thy servant Moses through the mouth of Thy glory, as it is said:

Thou didst make them hear the majesty of Thy voice and Thy holy words out of fiery flames. With thunder and lightning didst Thou reveal Thyself to them and with the sound of the Shofar didst Thou appear to them as it is written in Thy Torah:

tei:p.tei:seg: We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever.
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant.

And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.

tei:p.tei:seg: Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace.

In the book of life, blessing, peace and a good livelihood, may we be remembered and inscribed before Thee, we and all Thy people the house of Israel for a good life and for peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who makes peace.

tei:p.tei:seg: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking falsehood. Towards those who curse me, let my soul be silent and let my soul be as dust in relation to everything. Open my heart to Thy Torah and let my soul pursue Thy commandments and as for all those that devise evil against me, speedily frustrate their counsel and upset their plan. Do this for the sake of Thy Name, do this for the sake of Thy right hand, do this for the sake of Thy holiness, do this for the sake of Thy Torah so that those who love Thee may be delivered. Save with Thy right hand and respond to me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart find favour before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer.
May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.

tei:div.tei:p: as it is written in Thy Torah: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’. And it was said: ‘And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel, the Lord His God is with him and the royal Teruah within him.’ And it was said: ‘And He became King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel’. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘For dominion is the Lord’s and He is ruler over nations’. And it was said: ‘The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.’ And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in war. Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God’. And it was said: ‘Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s’. And it was said: ‘And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One’. And in Thy Torah it is written saying: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One’.

tei:div.tei:p: ‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark, and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’. And it was said: ‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’. And it was said: ‘I will remember my covenant with Jacob, as well as my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham will I also remember, and the land will I remember.’ And in Thy holy words it is written: ‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’. And it was said: ‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’. And it was said: ‘He remembered unto them His covenant and He reversed the decree according to the abundance of His kindness’. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem saying, ‘ThusThus says the Lord: I remember unto you the grace of your youth, the love of your betrothal, when you followed me in the wilderness in land unsown’. And it was said: ‘I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth and establish with you an everlasting covenant’. And it was said: ‘Is Ephraim a dear son to me, or a delightful child that whenever I speak of him, I still remember him? Accordingly, my love for him is aroused, I shall surely have compassion on him, says the Lord’.

tei:div.tei:p:
‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’. And it was said: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’. And it was said: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the
sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance’. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the Lord with a Shofar sound’. And it is said: ‘with trumpets and the Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’. And it was said: ‘Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered, on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob’. And it was said: ‘Halleluyah, praise God for His holiness, praise Him for the strong firmament. Praise Him for His mighty deeds, praise Him for the abundance of His greatness. Praise Him with the Shofar blast, praise Him with zither and the harp. Praise Him with timbrel and dance, praise Him with string instruments and flutes, praise Him with the clash of cymbals, praise Him with the ring of cymbals. Let all with breath praise the Lord, Halleluyah. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘all inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, when the banner is raised on the mountain shall you see and when the Shofar is blown shall you hear’. And it was said: ‘And on that day the great Shofar will be blown and the wanderers in the land of Assyria and the banished in the land of Egypt shall come and prostrate themselves to the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem’. And it was said: ‘And the Lord will appear to them and His arrow shall go forth like lightning and the Lord God will blow the Shofar and He will walk in the whirlwinds of the south. The Lord of Hosts will protect them’. So mayest Thou protect Thy people Israel with Thy peace.

tei:div.tei:p: From of old has this day been appointed for judgment, for testing every day’s work; the creatures approach the countenance of the Awe-inspiring One that on it He may grant them a verdict of deliverance. On this day was the first man created; he received a law but did not keep it; on this day did he find a defender (in God) who helped him in need and appointed it a day of judgment to be maintained for later generations. On this day the hewn out foundations, the hills and the rocks, were formed for the sake of the first of the forefathers; and they, as dwellers in the garden (Eden) were present at the work of creation that on this day they might plead for those created. This day’s month bears the name of the immortals (forefathers); it is a sign for those above and below to assemble for the books to be opened, for deeds to be related and for men to pass by Thee and render account. This day was appointed first for the order of Thy festivals, and for the flock to be led under the staff past Thee; when Thy witnesses blow remember the Shofar today, remember, O Merciful One, the oath of Thy servants.
The sound of the Shofar rises with prayer, Almighty, to appease Thee with supplication; return the flashing sword to its sheath, grasp the shield that we may shelter beneath it.
